title: Govee strip light fails to pair with app
shortDescription: Strip not detected by Govee Home app during Bluetooth/WiFi setup.
fullDescription:
Govee strip lights pair via Bluetooth first, then the WiFi-capable models join your network. Pairing fails if Bluetooth is off, location permission is denied, or the strip is not in pairing mode (rapid blue flash).

Govee uses a 'press and hold the on/off button for 5 seconds' to enter pairing mode on most controllers.
symptoms: Govee Home does not list nearby devices

fixSteps.title: Permissions
fixSteps.instruction: Grant Govee Home: Bluetooth, Location, Local Network permissions in phone settings.

fixSteps.title: Pairing mode
fixSteps.instruction: Press and hold the controller's on/off button for 5 seconds until LEDs flash rapidly.

fixSteps.title: Update app
fixSteps.instruction: Update Govee Home from the App Store/Play Store. Force-close and reopen.

faq.a: Android requires location permission to use Bluetooth scanning.

title: Govee device cannot join WiFi network
shortDescription: After Bluetooth setup, device fails to connect to WiFi.
fullDescription:
Govee WiFi devices are 2.4GHz only. Most failures are due to mixed-band SSIDs, special characters in passwords, or WPA3-only networks.

Some routers (especially mesh systems) need band-steering disabled during setup.

fixSteps.title: 2.4GHz only
fixSteps.instruction: Connect phone to 2.4GHz SSID before setup. Some routers require splitting bands temporarily.

fixSteps.title: Verify password
fixSteps.instruction: Avoid characters like &, $, % in WiFi password.

fixSteps.title: Reset device
fixSteps.instruction: Hold on/off 5 seconds to reset, retry pairing.

faq.a: No, all Govee WiFi devices use 2.4GHz only.

title: Strip does not react to music in Music mode
shortDescription: Music mode active but lights do not respond to sound.
fullDescription:
Govee Music mode uses either the controller's built-in mic or the phone's mic. If using phone mic, microphone permission must be granted to Govee Home. If using controller mic, the controller must be in a quiet location away from speakers and walls.

Sensitivity also needs adjustment in the music mode settings.
symptoms: Reacts only to very loud sounds
Reacts to phone but not room sound

fixSteps.title: Mic permission
fixSteps.instruction: Phone settings > Govee Home > Microphone: Allow.

fixSteps.title: Adjust sensitivity
fixSteps.instruction: In Music mode, raise sensitivity slider to 80-100%.

fixSteps.title: Reposition controller
fixSteps.instruction: Place controller in open air, not behind TV or in cabinet.

faq.q: Does Govee music mode use Spotify directly?
faq.a: No, it analyzes ambient sound via mic.

title: Device online but Govee Home cannot send commands
shortDescription: Status updates appear but commands fail.
fullDescription:
If Govee Home shows the device online but commands have no effect, the cloud-to-device path may be broken while telemetry-to-cloud works. This is often a temporary cloud issue or a stale auth token.

Logging out and back in usually clears it.
symptoms: Bluetooth control works but WiFi does not

fixSteps.title: Logout/login
fixSteps.instruction: Govee Home > Profile > Logout. Login again.

fixSteps.title: Restart device
fixSteps.instruction: Cycle wall power for 30 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Check firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Govee Home > device > Settings > Firmware update.

title: Half of Govee strip stays dark
shortDescription: One section of the strip does not light or shows wrong color.
fullDescription:
Many Govee strips have a midpoint connector where two halves meet. If a connector is loose or damaged, half the strip goes dark. The signal flows in one direction; if the data line breaks, everything past the break fails.

Reseating connectors and inspecting for damage usually solves it.
symptoms: First half works, second half dark

fixSteps.title: Power off
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug strip from wall.

fixSteps.title: Reseat connectors
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect every joint, inspect pins, reconnect firmly.

fixSteps.title: Replace connector
fixSteps.instruction: If pins are bent, order replacement Govee connector pack.

faq.q: Can I cut a Govee strip?
faq.a: Only at marked cut lines. Others damage the strip.

title: Strip color slowly drifts or wrong on parts of strip
shortDescription: Color appears different on segments of the strip.
fullDescription:
Long Govee strips can suffer voltage drop, where the LEDs furthest from the controller get dimmer power and shift toward red. This is a physical limitation of LED strips.

Using the dual-injection cable (where both ends of the strip are powered) eliminates the issue. Govee sells these for runs over 5 meters.

fixSteps.title: Use shorter run
fixSteps.instruction: Cut strip to recommended max length (5m for most kits).

fixSteps.title: Power both ends
fixSteps.instruction: Use a Govee dual-end power injector for runs over 5m.

videoSearchQuery: Govee strip color shift voltage drop

faq.q: Why does the end look red?
faq.a: Voltage drop reduces blue and green LEDs first.

title: Alexa fails to discover Govee devices
shortDescription: Alexa skill enabled but device not found.
fullDescription:
Govee has both a 'Govee' and a 'Govee Home' Alexa skill. Some older devices only work with one skill. Also, the device must be configured for Alexa in Govee Home settings.

Disabling and re-enabling the skill, then asking Alexa to discover devices, fixes most cases.
symptoms: Some Govee devices visible but not all

fixSteps.title: Use Govee Home skill
fixSteps.instruction: In Alexa app, disable 'Govee' skill if present. Enable 'Govee Home'. Link with same email used in Govee app.

fixSteps.title: Discover
fixSteps.instruction: Say 'Alexa, discover devices' or use Devices > + > Add Device.

faq.q: Do BLE-only Govee devices work with Alexa?
faq.a: No, they need WiFi or a Govee hub.

title: Strip flashes blue rapidly, in pairing mode
shortDescription: Strip is in pairing/setup mode and waiting for app.
fullDescription:
Rapid blue flash means the device is awaiting WiFi setup. If unintentional, you may have triggered a reset by holding the power button for too long.

Complete pairing in Govee Home or wait 90 seconds; if no app connects, device returns to last state.

fixSteps.title: Run setup
fixSteps.instruction: Open Govee Home > Add Device > follow prompts.

fixSteps.title: Wait
fixSteps.instruction: Wait 90 seconds; device exits setup mode if not paired.

title: Govee TV backlight does not match screen colors
shortDescription: Camera-based ambient mode shows wrong colors.
fullDescription:
Govee Immersion / DreamView TV kits use a camera clipped on the TV. Calibration aligns each LED to a screen zone. Misalignment, dim ambient lighting, or moved camera causes color mismatch.

Re-running the calibration wizard usually corrects it.

causes.cause: Calibration grid not visible to camera

fixSteps.title: Re-run calibration
fixSteps.instruction: Govee Home > device > Calibrate. Follow on-screen QR pattern.

fixSteps.title: Reduce ambient light
fixSteps.instruction: Dim room lights and close curtains during calibration.

fixSteps.title: Reposition camera
fixSteps.instruction: Center camera on top of TV pointing at full screen.

faq.q: Does Govee work on curved TVs?
faq.a: Yes, but calibration is more sensitive.

title: Govee firmware update fails or is stuck
shortDescription: Firmware update progress bar freezes or restarts.
fullDescription:
Govee firmware updates push from the cloud over the device's WiFi. Weak signal, app interruption, or the device being too far from the router cause failures.

Devices recover automatically; firmware images are signed so a half-applied update reverts.

fixSteps.title: Stay near device
fixSteps.instruction: Keep phone within 3 meters of device while updating.

fixSteps.title: Foreground app
fixSteps.instruction: Do not switch apps during update.

fixSteps.title: Retry
fixSteps.instruction: If failed, wait 5 minutes and retry from device settings.

faq.q: Will failed update brick my device?
faq.a: No, Govee firmware reverts on failure.
